generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

The x-axis (horizontal) represents the score ranges or categories.

The y-axis (vertical) represents the number of students in each score range or category.

Each bar represents a specific range of scores.

For each bar, look at the corresponding height on the y-axis. This tells you how many students fall into that score range.

So, for the first on the number of students who scored below \(60\%?\)

The bars range from \(0-20, 20-40,\) and \(40-60\) we read the y-axis the number of students against the bars and sum it all to have the total number of students who scored below \(60\%?={@ta1@}\)

We repeat the same procedure for the next question for students who scored above \(80\%?={@ta2@}\)
